bio: Run by the Frei family since 1982, this long-standing restaurant with its well-maintained shingle façade serves fresh, flavoursome seasonal fare rooted in classic cuisine and crafted from excellent ingredients. The set lunch is very popular. Tip: There is an especially fine selection of Swiss wines. Diners can choose between rustic cosiness and refined elegance in the various indoor spaces or head for the lovely tree-shaded terrace. Cosy guestrooms are available for overnight stays....
